subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should `mcp-app` widgets be part of this initial board protocol through a ticketed/reconstructable descriptor contract, or should this PR limit the public board surface to HTML widgets until that client boundary is designed?
rationale: The existing snapshot shape cannot render persisted MCP-app widgets, and choosing whether to expose a descriptor, a separate ticketed view, or defer the type defines a durable gateway/client contract rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Define an authorized MCP-app view contract
options.body: Expose the minimum descriptor or ticketed reconstruction path needed by the already-landed board client, with scope and lifecycle tests.

options.title: Defer MCP-app widgets
options.body: Remove or reject `mcp-app` from this initial public board surface and land the HTML-only domain with a separate tracked contract proposal later.

recommendation.title: Define an authorized MCP-app view contract
recommendation.body: Expose the minimum descriptor or ticketed reconstruction path needed by the already-landed board client, with scope and lifecycle tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The same contributor owns the related landed board UI work and the proposed server-side contract, so they are best placed to select or sponsor the boundary.
